rows.note: Texas does not license auto mechanics or repair shops: TDLR has no mechanic licence and ASE certification is voluntary. DPS licenses only vehicle inspection stations.

rows.regulator: Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation (TDLR)
rows.note: TDLR licenses electricians and electrical contractors; matched by licence type in TDLR's All Licenses dataset. TDLR's own search is the record.

rows.regulator: Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation (TDLR)
rows.note: TDLR licenses air conditioning and refrigeration contractors; matched by licence type in TDLR's All Licenses dataset.
Tailoring and alterations are not licensed.

rows.regulator: Bureau of Automotive Repair (BAR), Department of Consumer Affairs
rows.note: California's Bureau of Automotive Repair registers repair shops (Automotive Repair Dealers); check the shop's registration in DCA's license search.
CSLB licenses contractors. Its master list is a monthly download behind a form, too big for the worker, so a licence is checked on CSLB's Instant License Check.

An electrical contracting business holds a CSLB contractor licence, checked on CSLB's Instant License Check. Individual electricians are certified separately by the state's Department of Industrial Relations, which this check does not cover.
Small jobs under CSLB's value threshold need no contractor licence (unverified here): ask the job's value, then check CSLB for anything above it.
Tailoring and alterations are not licensed.

rows.regulator: Department of Business and Professional Regulation (DBPR)
rows.note: Florida's DBPR licenses construction contractors; checked on its license search.

rows.regulator: Department of Business and Professional Regulation (DBPR)
rows.note: Florida's DBPR licenses electrical contractors; checked on its license search.
New York's DMV registers repair and body shops.
Michigan's Secretary of State certifies mechanics.
